speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing your history. To begin our assessment, have you noticed any specific triggers for your ataxia, such as heat, exercise, or alcohol consumption, and do you experience any sensory disturbances like tingling in your hands or feet?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: I see; since the clumsiness is more pronounced on the right side, has this been steadily worsening over time, or did it come on suddenly after a specific event? Additionally, have you noticed any issues with your vision, such as double vision or difficulty focusing, which could suggest involvement of the brainstem or spinal cord?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.

REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain with contrast.
REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain.
